reproduction.expected: A trusted operator can select one GitHub repository, collect names-only onboarding metadata through authenticated HTTPS, persist a sealed sanitized artifact, and invoke the existing repository-onboarding-preflight without hand-authoring authority inputs.
reproduction.actual: The existing preflight accepts only a caller-supplied JSON document. No live GitHub metadata collector or root command owns repository identity, permissions, protected-main, Environment, Environment-secret-name, and remote workspace-marker acquisition.

violated_invariants: WP-08 repository metadata must describe one explicit live repository and must not be guessed or hand-promoted from an example.
GitHub credentials are transport prerequisites only; secret values must never enter onboarding metadata or evidence.
The existing repository_onboarding_preflight.py remains the sole readiness decision owner.
